title: Your Own Voice: Putting It Together
goal: Choose among the tools of B2 to write a short text in your own voice.
grammar: Your Own Voice: Putting It Together

items: I can choose the right register for the person I am writing to.
I can combine nouns, a concession, a certainty marker and a closing device in a short text.
I can write a short opinion text with a point, a reason, a concession and a conclusion.
